project.title: 16S rRNA  Enrichment of nitrogen fixing bacteria in a nitrogen deficient wastewater treatment system
project.description: Samples from sequencing batch reactors operated under high and low C:N using synthetic wastewater. Sequencing was performed in an Illumina Miseq platform using the primer set F515/R806 targeting 294 bp of the V4 region of the bacterial 16S rRNA gene
